video_title: LeBron Explains What Makes Jalen Brunson So Dangerous

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on Isaiah Thomas as a small guard
quotes.excerpt: I can't think of one besides Isaiah. Obviously we've had guys get close.

text_blocks.speaker: LeBron James
text_blocks.text: I can't think of one besides Isaiah. Obviously we've had guys get close. I think of Allen Iverson who got that team to the finals versus the Lakers in 2001.

text_blocks.speaker: Steve Nash
text_blocks.text: Steph is not a small guard though, is he?

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on why Stephen Curry isn't a traditional point guard
quotes.excerpt: I don't give Steph the point guard nod because he's so different.
quotes.quote: I don't give Steph the point guard nod because he's so different. With Zeke, you knew Zeke was the one, Dumars was the two. You knew he brought the ball up, he handled the rock, he was the point. With Steph, he's so dynamic to the point where he plays off the ball.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the importance of spacing for small guards
quotes.excerpt: You have to have the perfect team around a small guy, especially nowadays.
quotes.quote: You have to have the perfect team around a small guy, especially nowadays, the way the game's played where they space the floor so much offensively. For that small guy to be able to guard his yard is impossible. So you have to have these long Mikal Bridges, OG Anunoby, Josh Hart, Klay Thompson guys around him.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on Jalen Brunson's will to win
quotes.excerpt: The number one characteristic for me, and last year's clutch player of the year, is his will to win.
quotes.quote: The number one characteristic for me, and last year's clutch player of the year, this year I believe is Shai, last year was Jalen, is his will to win. One of the things I love about him beyond the shot-making is he's so smart at using his body.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the difficulty of guarding Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: If you're guarding him, you can't time it because you don't know when he's going to go.
quotes.quote: If you're guarding him, you can't time it because you don't know when he's going to go. It's not natural. He goes and then he just tosses it up there. It gets you leaning and then he's right there.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on teaching young guards to use their body
quotes.excerpt: I try to teach this to young guards, is using the body and cutting guys off.
quotes.quote: I try to teach this to young guards, is using the body and cutting guys off. There's one using your body to get off two feet and play. There's one where you have half an advantage where you steer them away from the pocket of space so you can then go back to the pocket of space. And the last one is how he gets in front and just stops.

quotes.speaker: LeBron James
quotes.summary_phrase: LeBron James on the unique challenge of defending left-handed guards
quotes.excerpt: He's a lefty, which also changes it too. Our league is 95 percent of our league are righties.
quotes.quote: He's a lefty, which also changes it too. Our league is 95 percent of our league are righties. And the lefties that's dynamic in our league is sometimes just hard to get a cadence to that. The man who is Jalen, the James Harden, now the Jalen Brunson, it's a different feel when a guy is coming at you lefty.

quotes.speaker: Steve Nash
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Nash on the difficulty of scheming against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: He's quite comfortable to shoot a hand-in-the-face three off the dribble if you give him a little gap.
quotes.quote: He's quite comfortable to shoot a hand-in-the-face three off the dribble if you give him a little gap. So that brings you all the way up. So then he creates that little advantage with the body whether he cuts you off, whether he takes you away from the space, or whether he plays off two feet.
